Persist the fake-hwclock state file across system updates.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value    |
| ------------ | -------- |
| Priority     | `600000` |
| Dependencies | None     |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Installs a Rugix state configuration for /etc/fake-hwclock.data. It does not
install fake-hwclock itself.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/persist-fake-hwclock"]
```
